Unlayer

Select a recording. When the local service is available, loudness measurement and instrument separation start automatically. A Retry button appears only if processing fails.

The play button previews the original until stems are ready. All six waveforms use the same start, end and moving playhead; click a waveform to seek. Solo and Mute affect playback, not the original-file measurements.

MP3, WAV, M4A, FLAC · 50 MB · Up to 10 minutes. Files are processed by the companion service on this device. Audio remains in page memory; backend stems expire after one hour. Some sound can overlap between estimated instrument parts. The Keyboard lane is an experimental piano estimate; synths may remain in Other.

No preset albums or library are loaded. Previous saved measurements remain untouched in browser storage.
